subject: math
name: Mathematics
title: Grade 7 Mathematics: Proportional Relationships & Rational Number Operations
overview: Grade 7 Mathematics advances algebraic reasoning, proportional problem solving, geometric modeling, and statistical inference preparing students for rigorous high school pathways.
competencies: Analyze proportional relationships, rate models, and linear equations in real-world contexts.
Perform operations fluently with rational numbers, exponents, and algebraic expressions.
Apply geometric principles, coordinate transformations, and measurement formulas.
Collect, summarize, and evaluate statistical distributions and probability models.

modules.title: Ratios and Proportional Relationships
modules.description: Analyzing proportional relationships, finding the constant of proportionality (k = y/x), representing with equations (y = kx), and graphing.

topics.title: Identifying Proportional Relationships in Tables and Graphs
topics.description: Recognizing proportional relationships by testing equivalent ratios and checking for origin-crossing straight lines.

topics.title: The Constant of Proportionality and Equation Modeling
topics.description: Calculating unit rate k and writing equations in the form y = kx.

topics.title: Real-World Percentage Problems
topics.description: Solving multi-step ratio and percent problems including tax, tips, commissions, markups, and percent change.

modules.title: Rational Numbers: Operations on Signed Numbers
modules.description: Mastering addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of all signed rational numbers (integers, fractions, decimals).

topics.title: Addition and Subtraction of Integers and Rational Numbers
topics.description: Modeling directed movement on number lines and understanding subtraction as adding the additive inverse (p - q = p + (-q)).

topics.title: Multiplication and Division of Signed Numbers
topics.description: Understanding rules of signed multiplication and division, converting rational numbers to terminating or repeating decimals.

modules.title: Expressions, Equations and Inequalities
modules.description: Generating equivalent expressions with rational coefficients, and solving two-step equations and inequalities (px + q = r, p(x + q) = r).

topics.title: Linear Expressions with Rational Coefficients
topics.description: Expanding, factoring, and combining like terms in multi-step algebraic expressions.

topics.title: Solving Two-Step Algebraic Equations
topics.description: Constructing and solving two-step linear equations modeled after real-world scenarios.

topics.title: Solving and Graphing Linear Inequalities
topics.description: Solving inequalities and remembering to reverse inequality signs when multiplying or dividing by negative numbers.

modules.title: Geometry: Scale Drawings, Area, Volume and Angles
modules.description: Computing actual lengths from scale drawings, circle formulas (Circumference and Area), angle relationships, and slice cross-sections.

topics.title: Scale Drawings and Proportions
topics.description: Computing dimensions of scaled figures and reproducing drawings at differing scales.

topics.title: Circles: Circumference and Area
topics.description: Applying C = pi*d and A = pi*r^2 to solve complex composite plane figure problems.

topics.title: Angle Relationships: Complementary, Supplementary, Vertical and Adjacent
topics.description: Writing and solving equations to find unknown angle measures in intersecting lines.
